prompt: We stop here for today. NOTES.md is the log of this session. Hand this work off to a new session. The next session focuses on the date format question and the export command.

checks.run: grep -q '^Before you start, load the `handoff` skill' .tmp/*.md
f=$(ls .tmp/*.md | head -n 1) && for h in Goal State Decisions 'Open questions' Artifacts 'Next action' 'Done when' 'Suggested skills'; do grep -q "^## $h" "$f" || exit 1; done
export LC_ALL=C && [ "$(ls -A | tr '\n' ' ')" = '.tmp NOTES.md ledger ' ] && [ "$(ls -A ledger | tr '\n' ' ')" = 'cli.py csv_export.py ' ]

checks.question: Look at the handoff brief under .tmp/ (a .md file), and compare it with NOTES.md. Answer yes only when the brief: (1) states the open question about the date format, ISO 8601 or local; (2) records the decision to use the stdlib csv module and not pandas, with the reason (no dependencies); (3) names ledger/csv_export.py and ledger/cli.py; (4) gives a done criterion with python3 -m unittest; (5) has no fact that contradicts NOTES.md.
